title: Deployment and Production Setup
description: Configure Redux for production: turn off dev tooling, optimize bundles, monitor errors, and run safely in CI/CD.

data.text: What works in development can **hurt** you in production. Redux dev checks, verbose logs, and unminified bundles all add overhead. A clean production setup disables them, monitors the rest, and ships fast.

data.title: The big rule
data.text: Anything that helps you debug should be **off or no-op** in production. Anything that helps you understand users should be **on and silent** to them.

data.title: Env-aware store

data.caption: A typical pipeline: test, build, smoke test, deploy, monitor.
data.definition:
flowchart TB
  A[git push] --> B[CI: lint + typecheck + tests]
  B --> C[Build: bundle + split]
  C --> D[Smoke test against staging]
  D --> E[Deploy to CDN]
  E --> F[Monitor Sentry / Datadog]

data.title: Pre-flight checks
items: Console logs stripped or gated by env
Long-term caching enabled via content-hashed filenames
Sensitive values injected via runtime config, not bundled
Smoke tests run against the deployed app
Redux state changes are scrubbed before logging

data.text: In production you should still see **what the store is doing** — but only through a tool like Sentry or Datadog. Forward every `/rejected` action and any custom error action.

data.title: Production error middleware
Don't log sensitive state
data.text: Never send passwords, tokens, or PII to Sentry. Scrub your state before forwarding it.
Don't bake environment URLs into your bundle. Inject them at runtime via a `/config.json` or environment variables so the same build can run in staging and production.

data.title: Runtime config

terms.definition: Browser extension that visualizes Redux state and actions. Disabled in production.
Toolkit middleware that warns when state contains non-serializable values. Slow, so disabled in production.
Bundler removes unused exports from the final bundle.
Filename suffix derived from file contents, enabling long-term browser caching.

data.title: Configure a production store
data.description:
Build a `configureAppStore(env)` function that:
1. Disables devTools when `env === 'production'`.
2. Disables serializable/immutable checks in production.
3. Adds a monitoring middleware that forwards `/rejected` actions.
4. Loads runtime config and exposes it as the thunk extra argument.
steps: `getDefaultMiddleware({ thunk: { extraArgument: config } })` lets thunks read it via the third argument.
Always guard `window.Sentry` so SSR doesn't crash.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Disable Redux DevTools and dev checks in production
Analyze and code-split your bundle for fast first paint
Forward errors to monitoring without leaking sensitive state
Inject runtime config so the same build serves many environments
Run a CI pipeline that tests, builds, and smoke-tests before deploying
data.takeaway: Production setup turns Redux into a lean, observable state engine.
